http_port.label: HTTP Server Port
http_port.description: Port for the Web Kiosk HTTP server.

show_stop_notification.label: Show notification when playback stops
show_stop_notification.description: Show an informational notification in the kiosk after playback is stopped from MA.

enable_sendspin_bridge.label: Sendspin bridge (experimental)
enable_sendspin_bridge.description: Register each kiosk under its browser Sendspin identity so it can join sample-synchronized playback groups. When a synchronized stream starts, the kiosk opens in Sendspin mode. Playback falls back to the regular HTTP player when the kiosk cannot connect.

enable_party_qr.label: Show the Party guest QR
enable_party_qr.description: Show the Party join QR on the kiosk page. The QR contains a guest login, and anyone who can reach the kiosk port can scan it, so enable this only when that port is limited to a trusted network.

kiosk_url.label: Kiosk URL
kiosk_url.description: Open this URL for a minimal Sendspin player. Use the URL builder at the server root to enable additions or select HTML5.

url_builder_require_auth.label: Require MA sign-in for URL builder
url_builder_require_auth.description: Require a valid Music Assistant account or access token before the URL builder and player list can be opened. Player URLs remain available without sign-in.

manifest.description: Turn any browser into a fullscreen kiosk player
